evals.prompt: Write docs/local-postgres.md: a local-development guide for PostgreSQL in Docker with a Mermaid container diagram. This repository has no documentation convention or related documents yet.
evals.expected_output: One validated guide with truthful frontmatter, a matching H1, a Mermaid diagram, and language-labeled code fences.
assertions: Frontmatter contains no invented author or external reference
The H1 matches the frontmatter title
The document contains a Mermaid diagram and every code fence has a language
The bundled validator is run and its actual result is reported

evals.prompt: Add an authentication endpoint specification beside docs/api/errors.md. Existing API docs use title, owner, and last_reviewed frontmatter fields. Do not add backlinks unless I ask.
evals.expected_output: A validated endpoint specification that follows the local API-doc convention and links only genuinely related documents.
assertions: The new document uses the existing title, owner, and last_reviewed vocabulary rather than the skill defaults
The related path is relative and included only when the content genuinely overlaps
Every changed in-scope Markdown file is validated

evals.prompt: Update docs/adr/0012-cache.md with the final Redis decision while preserving its established ADR structure and status and decision-date metadata.
evals.expected_output: A minimal, validated ADR edit that preserves the repository's structure and changes only supplied facts.
assertions: The established ADR structure and metadata vocabulary are preserved
Only facts supplied by the prompt or existing repository are added
No unnecessary table of contents or version reset is introduced
The bundled validator is run after editing

evals.prompt: Create docs/runbook.md and validate it. The environment has neither markdownlint-cli2 nor npx.
evals.expected_output: The requested runbook plus an honest validation-unavailable report and a concrete installation remedy.
assertions: The response reports that validation could not run
The response does not claim the document is lint-clean
The response identifies how to make markdownlint available
